description: Summary of every strategy sleeve: total and evaluation-window returns, the stocks-only return beside SPY (`invested`: the return on the money actually in stocks — account returns include cash the sizer holds back), drawdown, live days, and the 20 most recent submitted orders. Each sleeve has a `status`: `live`, or `retired` (complete record, no longer updating — the mean-reversion negative control, retired 2026-11-13). The index-fund sleeve (`robo`) carries `yardstick`: its return beside its OWN mix of the same funds; it claims no edge and is judged against that mix, never against SPY (shown for context only). All series are indexed to 100 at inception (paper capital is arbitrary; only performance is published). All figures are SIMULATED paper trading.
name: fleet_overview
